# Experiment pp01: reward yield versus camp damage

Base `2f0f534e8311ee597e516b11c2afca1bbf608060`, bot `leader_party_tuned` (NOT the rejected Focus candidate). Candidate `bots/pi_prospector-phase1-01/` only; write `IMPLEMENTATION.md`.

## Evidence and hypothesis

Current-engine head-to-head corpus:30 games between top3 teams,60 team views,328 physical actor appearances.59/60 team views complete at least one Prospector emblem;207 actors complete one, median round272;149 complete before halfway and182 later collect camp gems. Our original champion buys none. Evidence includes00quadrants match `01a1a981-8d45-7c14-948a-eda089b61acb`, Pantheon1023–679 Fish: both sides complete Prospector; losing Fish Marcella obtains it38, winning Pantheon Marcella72, so presence/earliness alone is not causal. Primary evidence is official current-engine summaries, cached on PC and unavailable to Pi.

Current engine3 runtime probe confirms Monster emblem cost150, five chosen-stat points, passive0.15; Prospector cost150, five points, passive0.25. Historical official rules describe15% damage to camps versus floor25% bonus to the holder's own captured reward share. Exact current sharing/rounding semantics remain under investigation. Both use five30-gold shards. This is a matched family substitution, not a stat/growth change.

Hypothesis: reward amplification at phase1 increases collected/banked gems enough to offset slower camp clearing from losing Monster's15% bonus. In a simplified damage-limited cycle without rounding,1.25/1.15 gives8.7% higher yield per time; actual capture/travel time, spell cooldowns, death, bag loss, overkill and contested captures can reverse the effect. Small shares<4 have no bonus under historical floor rules. Longer fights may make the passive strategically worse. Do not claim a guaranteed improvement.

Our recent04restricted_area loss `01a1a98a-aff6-70be-95ce-b9834f7d3b0f` had zero deaths and zero lost gems on both sides, but392 versus1092 collected, despite similar camp clear counts31–30 by500. This supports investigating economic yield/target choice rather than treating all losses as survival failures; it does not establish Prospector caused that gap.

## Exact isolated change

In `src/economy.cpp::shop`, change only the `second` choice (m.shop_phase==1) from Monster Focus/Strength to Prospector Focus/Strength. Use the EXISTING caster classification unchanged, so Marcella remains Strength. Do not inherit mf01. Preserve phase0 DurabilityHealth/VesperTreasureStrength, later Power phases, five-shard targets, item accounting, buying legality, costs, fuel guards, all configuration, roster, movement, camp selection, route estimates and combat. No logging/flags/refactors or other source changes. This first test deliberately leaves clear-time/routing heuristics unchanged; document that limitation.

## Checks and acceptance

Verify copied baseline identity and exact diff; unchanged classifications and phases. Existing meaningful native checks on Pi if available; no assertion test that simply restates this ternary. PC will compile exact pushed source on CLI5/engine3, verify engine purchase/combination events, same per-emblem stat points, phase continuation, and faults. Report actual checks/gaps accurately, leave commits to bridge.

Same fixed80-game screen as mf01:8 maps×5 frozen controls×both sides, with cached matching current-engine champion control64 common games (33 wins), whose artifact/map/seed/engine identities must match. Require zero candidate VM faults. Reject if direct champion wins<8/16 OR common wins<31/64. Expand only if direct wins>=9/16 AND common wins>=35/64; otherwise inconclusive pending mechanism inspection. Gates are exploratory screen heuristics; repeated use of the screen is development, not confirmation.

Record total and per-actor collections, banked/lost gems, deaths, camp clear counts, purchase/completion rounds and opportunity after completion, W/L/draw/faults and score deltas. Do not attribute improvement just to final inventory. No online upload based on screen. Broad diverse-opponent evaluation and frozen fresh confirmation required before recommendation.
